title: My Family
description: Learn to talk about your family members
objectives: Name family members (mother, father, brother, sister, etc.)
Talk about family relationships (This is my...)
Use 'have' to talk about family (I have a brother)

phrases: Do you have brothers or sisters?
target_language.grammar_pattern:
Possessives:
- My (for me)
- His (for a man)
- Her (for a woman)

Have:
- I have + noun
- He/She has + noun
- Do you have...?

Examples:
- This is my mother
- Her name is Fatima
- I have two sisters
- He has one brother

story.context: You show Marcus a photo of your family. You tell him about each person.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes! This is my family photo.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: This is my mother. Her name is Halima.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: Do you have brothers or sisters?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes. I have two brothers and one sister.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: Wow! Big family! What are their names?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My brothers are Ali and Omar. My sister is Amina. She is the youngest.

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: Nice! Do you have any children?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No, I don't have children yet.

drills.title: Drill 1: This is my...
drills.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct family member
drills.your_turn: Now introduce one of your family members, out loud, and record it

drills.title: Drill 2: His/Her name is...
drills.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word
drills.your_turn: Now say a family member's name using 'His' or 'Her', out loud, and record it

drills.title: Drill 3: I have...
drills.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word
drills.your_turn: Now say how many siblings you have, out loud, and record it

listening.question: Listen: How many brothers does the person have?
listening.transcript: Let me tell you about my family. I have two brothers and one sister.
listening.explanation: The person says 'I have two brothers'

listening.question: Listen: What is the mother's name?
listening.transcript: My mother is very kind. Her name is Halima.
listening.explanation: The person says 'Her name is Halima'

listening.question: Listen: Does the person have children?
listening.transcript: Do you have any children? No, I don't have children yet.
listening.explanation: The person says 'I don't have children yet'

speaking.title: Task 1: Introduce your family
speaking.instruction: Record yourself introducing 3 family members. Say their relationship to you and their names.
speaking.example: This is my mother. Her name is Halima. This is my father. His name is Mohamed. This is my sister. Her name is Amina.

speaking.title: Task 2: Family conversation
speaking.instruction: Record yourself answering these questions: Do you have brothers or sisters? How many? What are their names?
speaking.example: Yes, I have two brothers and one sister. My brothers are Ali and Omar. My sister is Amina.

writing.title: Task 1: Write about your family
writing.instruction: Write 5 sentences about your family. Include: parents, siblings, and children (if any).
writing.example:
1. My mother's name is Halima.
2. My father's name is Mohamed.
3. I have two brothers.
4. Their names are Ali and Omar.
5. I don't have children.

writing.title: Task 2: Describe your family
writing.instruction: Write a paragraph (6-8 sentences) describing your family. Who are they? What are their names?
writing.example: My family is from Somalia. My mother is Halima and my father is Mohamed. I have two brothers and one sister. My brothers are Ali and Omar. Ali is 25 years old and Omar is 22. My sister Amina is 18. She is the youngest. I don't have children yet.

sections.title: Possessive pronouns: My, His, Her
examples: My mother (I am talking about my own mother)
sections.question: How do we show that something belongs to someone?
sections.explanation: We use 'my' for ourselves, 'his' for males, and 'her' for females. These show possession or relationship.

sections.title: Have vs Has
sections.question: When do we use 'have' and when do we use 'has'?
sections.explanation: We use 'have' with I, you, we, they. We use 'has' with he, she, it. This is an important pattern.

sections.title: Questions with 'Do you have'
sections.question: How do we ask if someone has something?
sections.explanation: We use 'Do you have...?' for you, and 'Does he/she have...?' for other people.

quiz.question: You want to introduce your mother. What do you say?
quiz.explanation: 'This is my mother' is the correct way to introduce someone.

quiz.question: Your father's name is Mohamed. What do you say?
quiz.explanation: 'His' is used for males. So 'His name is Mohamed' is correct.

quiz.question: Your sister's name is Amina. What do you say?
quiz.explanation: 'Her' is used for females. So 'Her name is Amina' is correct.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: I ___ two brothers.
quiz.explanation: We use 'have' with 'I'. So 'I have two brothers' is correct.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: She ___ three children.
quiz.explanation: We use 'has' with 'she', 'he', or 'it'. So 'She has three children' is correct.

quiz.question: You want to ask if someone has brothers. What do you say?
quiz.explanation: 'Do you have brothers?' is the correct question form.

quiz.question: Someone asks 'Do you have children?' You have no children. What do you say?
options: No, I am not have children
quiz.explanation: 'No, I don't have children' is the correct negative form.

quiz.question: Which is CORRECT?
options: This is my mother. His name is Halima.
This is my mother. Her name is Halima.
This is my mother. Their name is Halima.
This is my mother. Its name is Halima.
quiz.explanation: Mother is female, so we use 'her'. 'Her name is Halima' is correct.

quiz.question: Write 5 sentences about your family. Include at least 3 different family members.
quiz.explanation: Use 'This is my...', 'His/Her name is...', and 'I have...' to describe your family.

quiz.question: Who is the most important person in your family? Why?
quiz.explanation: This is personal - there's no wrong answer. Practice expressing your thoughts in English.

somali.description: Baro sida xubnaha qoyskaaga looga hadlo
objectives: Magacaw xubnaha qoyska (mother, father, brother, sister...)
Ka hadal xidhiidhka qoyska (This is my...)
Isticmaal 'have' si aad qoyska uga hadasho (I have a brother)

sections.explanation: 'my' waxaan u isticmaalnaa nafteena, 'his' ragga, 'her'-na dumarka. Kuwani waxay muujiyaan lahaansho ama xidhiidh.
'have' waxaan la isticmaalnaa I, you, we, they. 'has' waxaan la isticmaalnaa he, she, it. Kani waa qaab muhiim ah.
'Do you have...?' waxaan u isticmaalnaa adiga, 'Does he/she have...?'-na dadka kale.
